'''Jerrod Lourdas''', or '''Vortex 4''' as his designation in [[Vortex Squadron (Arda I)|Vortex Squadron]], was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[T-47 sandspeeder/Legends|sandspeeder]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] who was assigned to Vortex Squadron at [[Arda Base]]. Shortly before the [[Battle of the Gauntlet (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of the Gauntlet]], he was assigned to patrol [[Torrence Run]], but skipped [[Sector 7]] to sweep [[Sector 17 (Arda I)|Sector 17]]. He liked to play [[Sabacc/Legends|Sabacc]] during his off-hours.<ref name="OAA1" />
